svg.title: Base Case: $925,000 Gross to $166,500 Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-billings-to-profit; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Case: $925,000 Gross to $166,500 Owner Profit; subtitle: Six bars distinguish billings, retained contribution, costs, and profit.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Annual USD. Opening, retained subtotal, and closing bars are absolute totals; negative bars are deductions. Retained share is 45%. The two pod-cost allocations are illustrative splits of the canonical $249,750 residual operating cost.; caption: $925,000 − $508,750 = $416,250 retained; $416,250 − $120,000 − $129,750 = $166,500 profit. Profit is 18.0% of gross billings and 40.0% of retained revenue.; stages: label: Opening gross contracted billings; value: $925,000 annual customer billings before driver settlements; numeric value: 925000.0; detail: Opening total: NEMT brokerage and medical courier service billings, excluding underlying healthcare charges and any unrelated client transaction volume.; label: Deduct external driver settlements; value: −$508,750 paid to contracted transport delivery providers; numeric value: -508750.0; detail: Deduction: 55% of gross billings compensates the external transport network. These providers are separate from the four-person administrative and dispatch pod.; label: Retained dispatch revenue subtotal; value: $416,250 retained under the canonical 45% share; numeric value: 416250.0; detail: Absolute subtotal, not another inflow. This model uses the specified ASC 606 agent presentation; actual net presentation requires a contract-specific principal-agent assessment and is not established by the percentage alone.; label: Deduct full-time pod seat costs; value: −$120,000 allocated to two full-time operating seats; numeric value: -120000.0; detail: Deduction: illustrative combined compensation and employment burden for the two full-time seats. If the owner fills a seat, keep seat compensation distinct from the residual owner-profit line.; label: Deduct remaining pod operating costs; value: −$129,750 covers contractor seats and other operating expenses; numeric value: -129750.0; detail: Deduction: illustrative aggregate for two contractor seats, dispatch software, insurance, billing support, credentialing, administration, and service exceptions. Do not deduct driver settlements a second time.; label: Closing annual owner net profit; value: $166,500 equals 18.0% gross and 40.0% retained margin; numeric value: 166500.0; detail: Closing total: canonical Base-Case annual owner profit. Working-capital funding is a cash requirement rather than an additional expense automatically deducted here.

text.title: Base Case: $925,000 Gross to $166,500 Owner Profit
text.tspan: Base Case: $925,000 Gross to $166,500 Owner Profit

circle.title: label: Opening gross contracted billings; value: $925,000 annual customer billings before driver settlements; numeric value: 925000.0; detail: Opening total: NEMT brokerage and medical courier service billings, excluding underlying healthcare charges and any unrelated client transaction volume.

label: Deduct external driver settlements; value: −$508,750 paid to contracted transport delivery providers; numeric value: -508750.0; detail: Deduction: 55% of gross billings compensates the external transport network. These providers are separate from the four-person administrative and dispatch pod.

label: Retained dispatch revenue subtotal; value: $416,250 retained under the canonical 45% share; numeric value: 416250.0; detail: Absolute subtotal, not another inflow. This model uses the specified ASC 606 agent presentation; actual net presentation requires a contract-specific principal-agent assessment and is not established by the percentage alone.

label: Deduct full-time pod seat costs; value: −$120,000 allocated to two full-time operating seats; numeric value: -120000.0; detail: Deduction: illustrative combined compensation and employment burden for the two full-time seats. If the owner fills a seat, keep seat compensation distinct from the residual owner-profit line.

label: Deduct remaining pod operating costs; value: −$129,750 covers contractor seats and other operating expenses; numeric value: -129750.0; detail: Deduction: illustrative aggregate for two contractor seats, dispatch software, insurance, billing support, credentialing, administration, and service exceptions. Do not deduct driver settlements a second time.

label: Closing annual owner net profit; value: $166,500 equals 18.0% gross and 40.0% retained margin; numeric value: 166500.0; detail: Closing total: canonical Base-Case annual owner profit. Working-capital funding is a cash requirement rather than an additional expense automatically deducted here.

text.title: Assumptions: Annual USD. Opening, retained subtotal, and closing bars are absolute totals; negative bars are deductions. Retained share is 45%. The two pod-cost allocations are illustrative splits of the canonical $249,750 residual operating cost.
